content.text: THE FUTURE OF DETROIT SPORTS HAS ARRIVEDDetroit SportsNet AnnualIn-Market StreamingYear-round access to watch Tigers games (starting now) and Red Wings games (starting with the 2026-27 season), when streaming each team’s local broadcast online! (Access to Red Wings games may require further action. Game availability subject to National Exclusivities and terms may apply).MLB.TV Watch EVERY out-of-market game LIVE or on demand at MLB or ESPN. Plus, stream MLB Network 24/7 (US Only), live MiLB games, MLB Big Inning and live audio for all MLB teams. Subscription renews on or around February 28, 2027. Available via ESPN, includes a free one-month trial of ESPN Unlimited.* Detroit TigersStream Tigers games without blackouts LIVE or on demand for the entire 2026 regular season. Plus, access to live MiLB games, MLB Big Inning and select local Pre/Postgame shows in the MLB app. For full details, visit tigers.com/detroitsportsnetfaqsDetroit Red WingsAccess to 2026-2027 Red Wings games (additional account registration and terms may apply). Subscription does not include access to current 2025-2026 Red Wings season. Details about how to stream Red Wings games will be shared ahead of the 2026-27 season. For full details, visit tigers.com/detroitsportsnetfaqsSubject to National Exclusivities*New subscribers who purchase MLB.TV can get a free one month trial of ESPN Unlimited. After initial purchase, ESPN subscription is not required to maintain MLB.TV subscription. Click here for more information about MLB.TV on ESPN. **Blackout and other restrictions apply. Detroit SportsNet Annual only available to residents of both the Tigers and Red Wings home television territories as determined by billing zip code. Click here for details about available in-market Tigers games on Detroit SportsNet in 2026. Information about available in-market 2026-2027 Red Wings games will be provided to subscribers prior to the start of the season. For a current listing of events and regular season Tigers games that will be nationally blacked out internationally and in the United States, click here. Blackout restrictions are based on geography and apply based on your physical location, which may be determined using various available factors, including IP address. Blackout restrictions subject to change. Please check this page periodically for updates. Data and usage rates may apply to the MLB app download and use. Subscriptions to 2026 Detroit SportsNet begin on April 1, 2026. Your payment card will be charged the current full annual price of $189.99 for Detroit SportsNet Annual or the first monthly payment of $19.99 for Detroit SportsNet Monthly on or about April 1, 2026. 2026 Detroit SportsNet includes in-market streaming access to 2026-2027 Detroit Red Wings games for all then-current subscribers. A separate account may be required to access Red Wings game content and additional terms and conditions may apply. Information about how to access Red Wings games for the 2026-2027 season will be provided to then-current Detroit SportsNet subscribers prior to start of the 2026-2027 Red Wings season. Detroit SportsNet Annual subscriptions will automatically renew annually on the later of April 1 or the anniversary of the date of purchase at the then-current year’s regular full price. Detroit SportsNet Monthly subscriptions will automatically renew each month then-current regular full monthly price. Subject to availability and blackout dates. Cancel any time before your next billing period. You can cancel online or by e-mail. For the full refund policy, click here.Blackout RestrictionsCheck local restrictions by typing in a zip code here:Due to certain Major League Baseball exclusivities, select regular season, special event and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally. For a full list of unavailable games, territories, and channels please click here.On Demand archives are available 90 minutes after the conclusion of games. Live audio of the games that are unavailable (such games listed here) is available to customers within MLB+, which is included with all MLB.TV subscriptions.In addition, note:Home television territory blackout restrictions apply regardless of whether a Club is home or away and regardless of whether or not a game is televised in a Club's home television territory.Clubs located within the United States may be subject to home television territory blackout restrictions that may expand to outside of the United States.All San Francisco Giants and Athletics live games will be blacked out in the U.S. territory of Guam.If you think we have inaccurately determined your home television territory blackout restrictions, you may call Customer Service at 866-244-2291 (US) and 315-203-6761 (International).
